summary: Effect 1 — Autonomous escalation: request_guidance blocking questions are auto-answered by an Opus CLI subprocess instead of pausing the loop. The requesting agent's tool call blocks ~30–60s while Opus decides, then returns { predicted: true, answer: "..." }. Falls back to normal blocking escalation if Opus is unavailable.
